preregistration: Alpha selection rule, written before the first live sweep (2026-10-24):
- Grid: alpha in {0, 0.1, ..., 1}, text-embedding-3-small at 512 dimensions, concept units.
- Data: dev split only of alpinaria (129 answerable dev queries) and atlas (62).
- Criterion: maximise the unweighted mean of alpinaria-dev Recall@5 and atlas-dev Recall@5.
- Ties (within 0.005 of the best mean): higher mean nDCG@10, then the smaller alpha (closer to lexical).
- One default for both fixtures (plan R-10; no per-fixture alpha).
- The 1,536-dimension run uses the chosen alpha on dev only; 512 stays the default unless 1,536
improves the dev mean Recall@5 by more than the larger of the two dev bootstrap half-widths.
- Held-out and full numbers are computed once, after the choice, and not used to revise it.

dimensions1536Dev.note: measured before the review fixes (alpha 0.4, tmm, no literal guard, depth 100)

chosen.rule: best mean dev Recall@5 of alpinaria and atlas over alpha 0..1 and the three normalizations: tmm 0.4 = 0.833 (tmm 0.5 = 0.829 is within 0.005 with a lower mean nDCG@10); best minmax 0.796 (alpha 0.1); lexical 0.746. 1,536 dimensions give the same dev mean (0.833), so 512 stays.

Pre-registered WP3c acceptance: alpinaria synonym Recall@5 >= 0.70: not met (0.557 -> 0.542; dev 0.542, heldout 0.542; section units reach 0.594).
Embeddings alone reach 0.81 on dev synonyms; fusion is the gap; per-query adaptive alpha is the follow-up.

Mixed-language >= 0.85: met (0.738 -> 0.881). No category regresses by more than its bootstrap CI: met (largest drops alpinaria synonym -0.016 against a half-width of 0.148, atlas keyword -0.022 against 0.067, atlas freshness -0.028 against 0.375). Exact: alpinaria 0.885 -> 0.894, atlas 1.000 -> 1.000. Atlas improves (0.760 -> 0.882). Hybrid p95 excluding query encoding: 34 ms at 5,000 concepts x 4 units (met), 162 ms at 20,000 concepts where lexical alone takes 100 ms (not met). Zero-result rate stays 0. lowConfidence reads the displayed top result: alpinaria precision/recall 66.7% / 54.5% (lexical 64.7% / 50.0%), atlas 63.6% / 70.0% (unchanged). Query encoding p50/p95 158/361 ms (alpinaria), 205/365 ms (atlas), reported apart from search latency.
notes: - Deviation from the pre-registration, on dev data only: the rule fixed the alpha grid under min-max; after the first sweep exposed a min-max artifact, two more normalizations were swept and the same rule applied across all grids; after the review fixes the sweeps were repeated for concept and section units and the same rule chose the units too. Held-out and full numbers were computed after each choice and never used to revise it.

- Section units stay configurable (embedUnits: sections). At their own dev choice (lexical-tmm 0.5) they win on synonyms (0.594) and mixed-language (0.905) but drop atlas keyword beyond its CI (0.956 -> 0.881); see the comparison table.
- The 1,536-dimension run was measured with concept units before the review fixes and gave the same dev mean as 512 (0.833); it was not repeated.
- The per-fixture search latencies come from the evaluation process; the scale benchmark is the reference for the 60 ms budget.
- Prompt tokens over every live run behind this report: 345,907 (about 0.0069 USD).
